# `grove` — `/api/grove`

Owner tools. Registry entries never grant filesystem or execution access.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | [`/api/grove/chat`](#post-api-grove-chat) | Host | One prompt to an Ollama model, answered whole (host only). |
| GET | [`/api/grove/models`](#get-api-grove-models) | Host | The models on the Ollama server the Grove uses (host only). |
| GET | [`/api/grove/projects`](#get-api-grove-projects) | Host | The host's projects (host only). |
| POST | [`/api/grove/projects`](#post-api-grove-projects) | Host | Adds a project (host only). |
| GET | [`/api/grove/server`](#get-api-grove-server) | Host | Disk use of the Grove's data folder and the workspace mode (host only). |

<a id="post-api-grove-chat"></a>
### `POST /api/grove/chat`

One prompt to an Ollama model, answered whole (host only).

- Handler: [`chat`](../../../backend/grove.py)
- Who may call: The host

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Chat`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 200 characters |
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 12000 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `text`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Local model response exceeded the limit. | `ollama` |
| 503 | Local Ollama is unavailable. Start it on this server and try again. | `ollama` |

<a id="post-api-grove-projects"></a>
### `POST /api/grove/projects`

Adds a project (host only).

- Handler: [`create_project`](../../../backend/grove.py)
- Who may call: The host

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `Project`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | at least 1 character; at most 80 characters |
| `description` | string | no | `""` | at most 4000 characters |

**Response**

- `201`: JSON object with `id`, `name`, `description`, `created`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Host access required. | `administrator` |

| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
